retarget.temporal_constraint: Enforce consecutive joint displacement <= existing 8 rad/s gate times 0.02 s inside every solve, including cold retry. Do not merely detect singular-knee velocity jumps afterward.
retarget.scope: Same CMU07/04 timing and source hashes; full pelvis/torso orientation, exact G1 limb scale and hip offsets; nominal arms. Marker endpoints are not soles: infer slow-foot intervals from horizontal AND vertical speed, not a global marker-height cutoff. Calibrate foot pitch from mid-stance, preserve heel/toe pitch, hold stance yaw and zero unobservable sole roll. Rock exact G1 capsule geometry about successive support endpoints. Blend source corrections through swing. SLSQP enforces joint/tendon/floor constraints and bounded root translation; reject failed fits before reusing a warm start.

protocol.fit_criteria_rationale: Human ankle/forefoot bone endpoints do not correspond exactly to G1 ankle origins or sole frames. The 2 cm/0.15 rad SOFT source-fit tolerances reflect sub-foot-size morphology/frame approximation, not physical constraint tolerances. Exact joint/tendon inequalities, 10 micrometre numerical floor tolerance, 4 mm planted-contact gap, 8 rad/s continuity and contact-point speed checks independently protect geometric validity. Root adaptation is bounded to 12 cm (less than one fifth of the 62 cm leg), allowing morphology and heel/toe transfer, not root teleportation in physics. Physical success criteria remain byte-for-byte equal to the v1 prospective criteria.
protocol.initialization: Initialize once from validated reference frame0 qpos and finite-difference qvel, including root translation and local angular velocity. Zero action history, as deployed. This is moving-mocap tracking, not learning to start walking from rest. No state overwrites, external forces or reference-dependent interventions after initialization.
